message.enderkinesis.sselith_madness.sta: Something out there... what is its name?
You can feel the shelves reaching out to you, as if by name.
The edges of the paper tug back at you...
You already know the way to go, just trust yourself.
Is it even yourself? What separates you from them?
You hear a faint fluttering in the distance
If you could only remember what that book said on your way in...
Vraest, moroch? Skarn? What do those words mean?
I don't understand my own thoughts anymore. Who am I? Am I Sselith?
